newsitem.title: USA: Hutchinson sees shipment growth at 33 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hutchinson sees shipment growth at 33 pct.

text.p: Hutchinson Technology Inc expects the volume of its shipments to grow about 33 percent in the rest of its fiscal year ending in September, and probably calendar 1997 as well, its chief executive said on Tuesday.

At a Hambrecht and Quist technology conference in San Francisco, Chief Executive Wayne Fortun said the company expected its shipment growth to return to the 33 percent rate it experienced over the past two years.
He said a jump in shipments growth to 70 percent in the first quarter was not likely to be repeated in the rest of the year.
Shares in Hutchinson, which makes suspension assemblies for computer disk drives, were two points higher at 26-3/4 early Tuesday afternoon.
